question: Which public, measured datasets could constrain parameters/outputs of the nine-region gas-exchange model in inputs/Q021_model.py?

model_groups.G1: regional perfusion distribution (hydrostatic terms, extra-alveolar resistance law)
model_groups.G2: regional ventilation distribution (airway resistance and compliance gradients)
model_groups.G4: O2 carriage curve (hb_g_dl, p50_mmHg, hill_n, o2_dissolved_ml_dl_mmHg, o2_binding_ml_g)
model_groups.G5: state amplitudes at rest and at load (VA, Q, VCO2, PvO2, RQ)
model_groups.G6: model outputs / failure modes (A-aDO2, regional-minus-homogeneous A-aDO2, nondep/dep perfusion ratio, regional V/Q)
model_groups.G7: regional geometry (n_regions, lung_height_m, per-region volume/compliance weights)

metadata_rule: every licence/size/format/subject-count value below was read from a publisher API or landing page fetched during this job and stored under provenance/. No value is quoted from memory.

candidates.title: Perfusion quantification data for "Towards Quantitative Perfusion MRI of the Lung in COPD: The Problem of Short-Term Repeatability"
candidates.licence: CC BY 4.0 (publisher termsOfUse field: 'Data is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License')
candidates.format: 2 files: comma-separated table with 46 columns (1 header row, 1976 data rows) + plain-text data dictionary
candidates.format_discrepancy: declared text/tab-separated-values but the deposited file contains 0 tab characters; delimiter sniffed as ',' (reported, not silently fixed)
candidates.subjects: 19 prospectively enrolled COPD patients (median age 66 y), numbered 1-20 with no No 4; 4 measurements each = 2 days x (room air, 100% O2) = 76 measurements
candidates.regional_structure: lungs split into 12 regions of equal volume: left/right lung each divided into upper/middle/lower thirds, each third split into front/back; also merged front+back and per whole lung; 42 region columns with and without vascular suppression (VS)
candidates.variables: MTT [s], PBF [ml/100ml/s], PBV [ml/100ml], Volume [mm^3], Volume [Voxels], each as mean/median/min/max/Q.25/Q.75/StdDev/valid voxels

constrains_model_groups.G1: regional perfusion distribution: gives flow per lung third, i.e. a measured apical/axial perfusion gradient to test art_hydro_fraction, ven_hydro_fraction, rv_top_relative, rv_base_gradient, exercise_recruitment
constrains_model_groups.G3: hpv_gain: paired 100% O2 vs room-air acquisitions give the oxygen-responsive vasoconstriction direction and size in humans (hypoxia is the model's stimulus; hyperoxia is the reverse direction)
constrains_model_groups.G6: nondependent/dependent perfusion ratio: the model's headline output is compared against the measured upper/lower ratio
constrains_model_groups.G7: per-region volume weights: Volume [mm^3] per region is a measured substitute for the model's equal-height 9-column volume weights

candidates.admissibility_reason: E1 open; E2 measured humans; E3 maps to G1/G3/G6/G7; E4 size/format/subjects read from heiDATA API; E5 licence stated by publisher; E6 not internal
second_route_K1: provenance/datacite_zpezpx.json (DataCite: publisher heiDATA, rights openAccess + custom terms, sizes ['562063','1275'])
provenance/heidata_zpezpx_files.json (heiDATA file API: per-file id, filesize, md5, restricted=false)
known_defects: data dictionary states PBF in [ml/100ml/s]; at those units the file implies ~879 L/min for the six merged thirds, ~2 orders of magnitude above any cardiac output, so the stated time unit is probably wrong
body posture not stated in the file, so 'upper third' cannot be assumed nondependent
publisher's declared file size 562063 B differs from the 554870 B transferred (md5 matches the publisher's declared md5 exactly)

candidates.title: Supplementary Material for: Lobar Quantification by Ventilation/Perfusion SPECT/CT in Patients with Severe Emphysema Undergoing Endoscopic Lung Volume Reduction

constrains_model_groups.G2: regional (lobar) ventilation distribution and regional volumes
